title: 第19章 来了吗第20章 又出问题了
slug: 夫人她只想修仙第370章自爆
content_zh:
她站了一天桩功，依然忍不住去想，去念。
修炼结束后赶忙去尘云峰——林端的住处——一探究竟。
颜筝在山顶的卧房找了许久，最后却在山脚的药坊找到了满身药渣的大师兄。
“天又亮了？”
林端奇怪道。
“没有，不是，我来找你问问问题！”
颜筝气喘吁吁。
幸好林端的尘云峰不高，否则像凌云峰一般高耸入云，想爬到山顶，难如登天啊！
林端抬头看了她一眼，一听天还没亮，拍拍衣袖的药渣，一个转身又回了药圃，随口道：“你想问什么？”
颜筝便连忙把和颜桐说的那些一五一十的转述了。
“他一直希望自己是火灵根。”
林端头也没抬，淡淡道，“他来北山宗前发生了什么，我不知晓，但听掌门说，不大好，而他来北山宗后，发生了一件事，刺激到他了。”
五行灵根作为根本，单个出现的概率极低，但作为杂灵根却是不少。
北山宗有火灵根的弟子不少。
一日那么不小心，火便连成了一片。
“云熠当时还小，说什么也要去灭火。”
林端说。
颜筝问：“结果呢？”
沈云熠现在都才只是炼气，小的时候只会更惨吧？
“结果可想而知，他能灭个什么火？”

林端终于放下手中的药材，他着颜筝，轻声道，“他始终觉得，火灵根是世上最强的灵根，水灵根则是世上最弱的灵根，是以，一直戴红色发带，穿红色衣服。”
“水灵根到底怎么他了？”
颜筝嘴角抽搐，“这不纯小孩吗？”
“他的确还是孩子，你也是。”
一听这话，颜筝瞬间炸毛：“和我有什么关系，你别把事情扯到我身上呀！
我也未必是火灵根吧？”
她对什么极品不极品，单不单灵根真无所谓。
基至她还巴不得自己资质奇劣无比，这样宗门兴许会放她到哪个山头平，平淡的过完一生。
当然，是在治完病后。
“你的确不一定是火灵根拥有者，但师尊出面保下你，一定有他的理由。”
林端又低下头配药了，“六十的概率土灵根，四十火灵根。”
虽然不知道林端这个结论从何而来，但师兄这么说，自然有他的原因。
“你很不相信我是火灵根？”
“当然。”
林端亳不犹豫，“火灵根进攻性太强，你还是适合打打辅助。”
颜筝火大：“你什么意思？看不起女生吗！”
进攻性强咋了！
content_en:
She stood doing the exercises for a whole day and still couldn't help but think about it and recite it.
After practicing, he hurried to Chenyun Peak—Lin Duan’s residence—to find out.
Yan Zheng searched for a long time in the bedroom at the top of the mountain, but finally found her senior brother covered in medicine residue in the medicine shop at the foot of the mountain.
"It's daylight again?"
Lin Duan said strangely.
"No, no, I'm here to ask you a question!"
Yan Zheng was panting.
Fortunately, Chenyun Peak in Linduan is not high, otherwise it would tower into the clouds like Lingyun Peak. Climbing to the top of the mountain would be as difficult as climbing to the sky!
Lin Duan raised his head and glanced at her. Hearing that it was still dark, he patted the medicine residue on his sleeves, turned around and returned to the medicine garden, and said casually: "What do you want to ask?"
Yan Zheng quickly recounted everything she had said to Yan Tong.
"He always hoped that he was the Fire Spirit Root."
Lin Duan didn't even raise his head, and said calmly, "I don't know what happened before he came to Beishan Sect, but the leader said it was not good. But after he came to Beishan Sect, something happened that irritated him."
As the root of the Five Elements Spiritual Root, the probability of appearing individually is extremely low, but as a miscellaneous spiritual root, there are many.
Beishan Sect has many disciples with fire spirit roots.
One day, accidentally, the fire broke out.
"Yun Yi was still young at the time, and he would put out the fire no matter what."
Lin Duan said.
Yan Zheng asked: "What's the result?"
Shen Yunyi is just refining his Qi now. It would have been even worse when he was young, right?
"The results can be imagined. What kind of fire can he put out?"
Lin Duan finally put down the medicinal materials in his hand. He put on his face and said softly, "He has always felt that the fire spirit root is the strongest spiritual root in the world, and the water spirit root is the weakest spiritual root in the world. Therefore, he always wears a red headband and red clothes."
"What happened to Shui Linggen?"
The corner of Yan Zheng's mouth twitched, "Isn't this a pure child?"
"He is indeed still a child, and so are you."
Upon hearing this, Yan Zheng was furious: "What does it have to do with me? Don't blame me!
I may not be a fire spirit root, right? "
It doesn't matter to her whether it's the best or not, just spiritual roots.
Basically, she wished that her qualifications were extremely inferior, so that the sect might let her live a peaceful life on some mountain top.
Of course, after treatment.
"It is true that you may not be the owner of the Fire Spirit Root, but Master must have his reasons for protecting you."
Lin Duan lowered his head to prepare the medicine again, "The probability is sixty for earth spiritual roots and forty for fire spiritual roots."
Although I don't know where Lin Duan's conclusion came from, my senior brother certainly has his reasons for saying this.
"You don't believe that I am a fire spirit root?"
"Of course."
Lin Duanbo did not hesitate, "Huo Linggen is too offensive, so you are still suitable for supporting."
Yan Zheng was furious: "What do you mean? Do you look down on girls!"
How offensive!
